prompts.name: 회색 후드·조거팬츠 남성
prompts.subject: Korean adult man late 20s with a broader, slightly stocky build, short black cropped hair, loose warm-light-gray hooded sweatshirt with hood DOWN, muted olive tapered jogger pants with cuffed ankles, off-white sneakers. No backpack and no bag. No logos. A quiet relaxed everyday neighborhood walk.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: production EIGHT-DIRECTION pedestrian sprite atlas for a Korean residential-alley webtoon.
The reference image is STYLE AND LAYOUT reference only. Create a NEW person described below in the exact same clean simple style. Do not copy the reference person's outfit.
Canvas: 1536x1024 transparent PNG. Exactly eight full-body views in an invisible 4-column by 2-row grid, cells 384x512. One centered figure per cell, same scale and body proportions, crown approximately 25px below cell top and shoe bottoms 490px below cell top. Leave transparent gutters and all feet/hair fully visible.
View order, left to right: TOP 0 front toward viewer; 1 front three-quarter toward screen RIGHT; 2 strict side profile toward screen RIGHT; 3 rear three-quarter toward screen RIGHT. BOTTOM 4 full back; 5 rear three-quarter toward screen LEFT; 6 strict side profile toward screen LEFT; 7 front three-quarter toward screen LEFT.
All depict the SAME ordinary frozen walking stride rotated around the body, not different animation poses. Relaxed arms, small step, empty hands, no unusual action.
Style: faceless Korean webtoon background extra, natural adult proportions. Face has absolutely NO eyes, eyebrows, mouth, nose marks, blush, or expression: uniform pale peach blank shape. Separate single SOLID flat fill for skin, hair, EACH garment, and each shoe. ZERO shading, gradient, highlights, fabric texture, hatching, or shadows. Sparse subtle local-color seam lines, gentle silhouette outline matching fill. No black heavy outlines. Desaturated wearable colors.
Transparent background, no scenery, floor, contact shadow, labels, text, logos, grid lines or extra objects.
